about_the_game:
NOISZ episode G is the second story expansion for NOISZ, exploring the tale of Gaius Antiphon long before the events of Ignition and re:||VERSE with 6 brand-new stages! Challenge new and old content with the tricky mechanics of Proto Style, further expanding your Style Lab possibilities, and earn more achivements and titles!

Now, let's see how it all began...
